blurb: Guests can ride the only banana boat in New Jersey, pulled behind a speedboat for a thrilling 30-minute ride. They can also enjoy tubing, wakeboarding, and waterskiing with instruction and a boat cruise around the bay. Sunset boat cruises offer back bay or ocean trips with potential dolphin sightings and BYO wine and cheese.

Lots of fun, friendly staffMorgan checked us in and she was super friendly and personable! My daughter and her 2 friends had a blast! It was a great experience from start to finish! Will definitely be back next summer!– tlosugarbooger, TripAdvisor
